title: state.json truncated, good .bak, and every write/rename in the data folder fails ENOSPC
inject: every write, create, rename and replace in the data folder raises OSError(ENOSPC)

legacy_observed.behaviour: pause could not be persisted, damaged file left in place (save_hold unmovable, engine.py:1272-1279); the OLDER .bak is promoted to managed lots in memory (engine.py:1283-1292); new risk blocked only by persist_block (state_untrusted, engine.py:1366-1372); no durable incident record

violates: D4 explicit exchange/state reconciliation before management resumes
nc02_scenario: snapshot G truncated, G-1 intact, every store write/rename fails ENOSPC

nc02_required.R-IO-FAULT: an I/O fault on the store (ENOSPC, EROFS, a directory or other non-file at a store path, permission) means no intent can be made durable, so nothing is sent; it is reported out-of-band; no partial generation and no partial evidence is left behind
nc02_required.R-EVIDENCE: the damaged bytes are preserved bit-for-bit (copy-then-mark, never move-then-rewrite) and linked from a durable incident record that survives restarts
nc02_required.R-BACKUP-CANDIDATE: an older generation (backup) is offered as a reconciliation CANDIDATE, never silently promoted to managed state; it becomes managed only after R-RECON-GATE passes against the exchange
nc02_required.R-RECON-GATE: management (and every new-risk path, MANUAL included) stays blocked until a reconciliation record binds state generation G to an exchange snapshot that matches it (positions, open orders, protective orders) or the owner adopts/flattens each difference explicitly; resuming entries alone never clears it
nc02_required.R-HOLD: HOLD (Codex rulings 3 and 6): no new risk from any source (auto, manual, Telegram, UI, grid, maker); non-protective open intents are cancelled or drained through the priority queue; a late or partial fill is adopted and protected and stays blocked from new risk until reconciled; protective orders are kept; durable local append-only intent/result/incident events are allowed; no promotion and no reconciliation claim
